title: Annual Safety Review series

verified_observations.archive: EASA exposes an Annual Safety Review archive with editions covering the BSFM evaluation interval.
verified_observations.fatal_accident_appendices: Recent editions expose Appendix 1, List of Fatal Accidents.
verified_observations.global_context: ASR 2025 reports worldwide fatal-airline-accident context for 2024 in addition to European commercial-air-transport analysis.

limitations: EASA annual reviews are not assumed to be a Boeing-only census.
Edition structure and appendix availability may differ by year and must be verified year by year.
Each candidate event still requires BSFM Boeing/commercial/fatal target adjudication and duplicate reconciliation.
Global-context counts alone cannot attest a BSFM census year.
